_comment: The colony calendar (#67). A calendar day passes only on a game day when a colony member spent nearMinutes inside the colony, so a server running with nobody on doesn't burn through holidays. Holidays: season 0-3 (spring, summer, autumn, winter), day 1-seasonDays; occasion is a row of moods.json; text is what the colony is told (for the model, in English); favours are gifts that count as loved that day (an item id, 'food' or '~word', as in gifts.json); special is code's part: fair, tournament, remembrance (skipped while nobody has died), gift_exchange, year_end.

holidays.name: Founding Day
holidays.text: Today is Founding Day, the anniversary of the colony: people remember how it all began and how far it has come.

holidays.name: Flower Festival
holidays.text: Today is the Flower Festival: spring is here, people wear flowers and give them to each other.

holidays.name: Summer Fair
holidays.text: Today is the Summer Fair: everyone shows off their work and argues over whose is best.

holidays.name: Guards' Tournament
holidays.text: Today is the Guards' Tournament: the guards compete, everyone else cheers and bets.

holidays.name: Harvest Festival
holidays.text: Today is the Harvest Festival: the colony gives thanks for the harvest, to the farmers and the cooks above all.

holidays.name: Night of Remembrance
holidays.text: Tonight is the Night of Remembrance: the colony quietly remembers those who are gone.

holidays.name: Gift Exchange
holidays.text: Today is the Gift Exchange: everyone secretly gives someone a small present and tries to guess who gave theirs.

holidays.name: Year's End
holidays.text: Today is Year's End, the last day of the year: people look back on it and wish each other a better one.
